{{Quote|Unless, of course, I could interest you in some Polordion smootdust? One hundred percent pure, satisfaction guaranteed&mdash;|Elan Sleazebaggano|<ref name="Boba Fett: Pursuit">''[[Boba Fett: Pursuit]]''</ref>}}
'''Polordion smootdust''' was a [[Spice/Legends|drug]] used in [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant's]] [[Coruscant Underworld/Legends|underlevels]]. [[Slythmonger/Legends|Slythmonger]] [[Elan Sel'Sabagno/Legends|Elan Sel'Sabagno]] once attempted to sell Polordion smootdust to the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]].
